root_text:
SYMPTOMS FOR HMPV !

Symptoms of HMPV are very much similar to the
symptoms of common cold like 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡, 𝐫𝐮𝐧𝐧𝐲 𝐨𝐫
𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐟𝐟𝐲 𝐧𝐨𝐬𝐞, 𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐚𝐭. If the virus is 
affecting a lot then you may even require 
hospitalisation.

#HMPV 
Team @HaalChaal_N
